data.narrative:
Lodge Systems is a pre-seed stage company operating in Defense & Security, a sector with 21 identifiable peers (2 public, 8 private comps identified). The comparable universe includes established private players such as Anduril Industries, Helsing, Shield AI, Saronic, and Quantum-Systems, alongside public peers DRSHF and IDEAFORGE.NS.

The peer-median method proved inapplicable to this valuation. The Defense & Security comp set, while substantial at 21 total peers, contains insufficient granularity at pre-seed stage: zero same-stage matches, one adjacent-stage comparable, and zero companies in a similar valuation tier. Applying the all-sector median under these constraints would introduce material bias and misrepresent the capital formation dynamics specific to early-stage defense technology. The requirement of at least three datapoints within a cohesive filtering criteria was not satisfied.

Given the methodological constraints, a rigorous triangulated valuation cannot be supported by the available data. Pre-seed stage companies in Defense & Security occupy a capital formation environment distinct from their growth-stage counterparts, and the sparse overlap between Lodge Systems' profile and the identified comp set limits derivation of reliable benchmarks. Valuation work would require either (a) expanded private market dataset granularity at pre-seed stage, (b) bespoke analysis of founding team track record and IP defensibility, or (c) direct investor signals from comparable funding rounds. The key uncertainty remains the absence of stage-appropriate comparable transactions.
